title: 飞翔矩阵
description: 这是一件动态装置作品，作品单元在MCU的控制下可以呈现某种韵律的运动，色彩、形态、运动在此互相关联。单元形态取材于大雁，也是在火神祝融的感召下构建了作品。
description_en: A kinetic installation whose individual units move in rhythmic patterns under the control of microcontrollers (MCUs). Colour, form and movement are interwoven. The units take their form from wild geese; the work was also inspired by Zhurong, the god of fire.

title: 零和世界
description:
这是一件以纯代码生成的数字作品，作品实时运算，尺寸可变。
描述整体事件的此消彼长，息息相关。
description_en:
A digital work generated entirely through code, computed in real time and variable in scale.
It explores the ebb and flow of interdependent events within a larger whole.

title: 游于艺之洛伦兹吸引子
description: 这是一件小型的互动装置，以画凳上的两个游戏摇杆控制中间的LED矩阵，合适的动作会引发矩阵的某种具备排列的闪灭。
description_en: A small interactive installation in which two game joysticks mounted on a painting stool control an LED matrix between them. Particular movements trigger ordered patterns of light flashing on and off.

title: 王小波与陈清扬
description: 这是一件物理世界、数字世界与精神世界互相映射的例子。王小波的小说曾经影响过我的青年时代，小说中的主人公陈清扬、我曾经使用过的旧电脑与游戏摇杆形成三者的对应。
description_en: This work explores reciprocal mappings between the physical, digital and inner worlds. Wang Xiaobo's fiction influenced me in my youth. Chen Qingyang, a protagonist in his fiction, an old computer I once used, and a game joystick form a three-way correspondence.

title: 以物形诗之形式机器
subtitle: 单体
description: 这是以物形诗系列作品中的一件。作品把真实物体的形态映射为某个字符，然后把字符像诗歌一样在上海的一个废弃的工厂煤道内进行呈现。
title_en: Poetry Shaped by Objects: Formal Machine
description_en: Part of the Poetry Shaped by Objects series. The work maps the forms of physical objects to characters, then presents these characters like poetry inside a coal passage in an abandoned factory in Shanghai.

title: 以物形诗之缓冲区
subtitle: 整体
description: 这是以物形诗系列作品中的一件。在某段时间我比较坚定地认为一切都是形式（彻底意义上的形式），所以构建了一个电子游戏机来体现此概念（游戏机的机体是一个废弃的教堂椅）。
title_en: Poetry Shaped by Objects: Buffer Zone
description_en: Part of the Poetry Shaped by Objects series. For a time, I held a strong conviction that everything was form—in the most radical sense of the word. I built a video game machine to embody this idea, using a discarded church pew as its cabinet.

title: 向量空间
description: 这是早年的一件互动装置作品，作品内运行着一个小型的ANN（人工神经网络）以此来应对外部的互动。
description_en: An early interactive installation that runs a small artificial neural network (ANN) to respond to interaction from the outside world.

title: 下雨天我在朽木中做了一只AI虫子
description: 我把一只数字虫子（带有简单的ANN）装进了一根废弃的老树中。观众使用游戏摇杆与虫子交互。这实际上也是一件电子游戏作品。
title_en: On a Rainy Day, I Made an AI Insect in Decaying Wood
description_en: I placed a digital insect, equipped with a simple artificial neural network (ANN), inside a discarded old tree trunk. Visitors interact with the insect using a game joystick. This is also, in essence, a video game work.
